subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw accept a v13 per-transcript generation table and a public generation-aware raw transcript cursor API as supported long-term contracts?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically covered, but choosing to persist this state and publish this Plugin SDK abstraction is a compatibility and product-boundary decision that tests cannot make.

options.title: Sponsor both contracts
options.body: Approve the v13 migration and public SDK reader, with maintainers accepting the documented upgrade and external-plugin compatibility obligations.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Rework the change so active-memory uses an internal bounded read owner and no public raw cursor or schema-version bump is introduced.

options.title: Defer the foundation
options.body: Pause this PR until a broader transcript-storage and Plugin SDK direction is explicitly agreed.

recommendation.title: Keep the optimization internal
recommendation.body: Rework the change so active-memory uses an internal bounded read owner and no public raw cursor or schema-version bump is introduced.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor owns the current proposal and can incorporate the selected direction, while a repository owner must supply the final product decision.
